title: Tek It
lyrics:
[00:00.07]Where did you learn what it means to reciprocate?
[00:06.26]And how much can I be expected to tolerate?
[00:12.56]So I started to think about the plans I made, the debt unpaid
[00:19.38]And you just can't call a spade a spade
[00:26.13]I watch the moon, let it run my mood
[00:34.11]Can't stop thinking of you
[00:39.10]I watch you (And I watch as things play out like)
[00:45.66]So long, nice to know you, I'll be moving on
[00:52.19]We started off in such a nice place
[00:55.62]We were talking the same language
[00:58.89]I o-open, and I'm closing
[01:02.12]You can't stand the thought
[01:04.30]Of a real beating heart, you'd be holding
[01:07.62]Having trouble, o-o-owning
[01:10.90]And admit that I am hoping
[01:15.06]I watch the moon, let it run my mood
[01:23.07]Can't stop thinking of you
[01:28.08]I watch you (And I watch as things play out like)
[01:34.63]So long, nice to know you, I'll be moving on
[01:41.23]Moving on
[02:10.66]You, yeah, I always know the truth
[02:14.93]But I can't just say it to you
[02:18.53]Yeah, I know the truth
[02:22.99]I knew, yeah, I always know the truth
[02:28.02]But I can't just say it to you
[02:31.56]Yeah, I know the truth
[02:37.12]I never thought we'd see it through
[02:40.36]I never could rely on you
[02:43.69]And a few times, your face came into view
[02:52.06]Into view
[02:54.58]I'm not into you
[02:58.59]Into view
